T-27 membership-only + token-only admins in tenant B, T-26 TA binding converted to routing kind, T-32 pinned keys computed outside Elixir + 1,000-name range and uniqueness, T-33 held lock blocks / other tenant does not / ArgumentError / re-entrant, T-34 tripwire, T-35 oracle); identity/audit_context_test.exs 14 (pure, async). T-29 batch A (pending_admin_binding, pending_admin_grants, role_backfill, tenant_admin_migration, tenant_auditor_seeding, identity_test, identity_login_directory, role_registry, identity_role_rebind, identity_roles_guard): 'Finished in 372.9 seconds' / 'Result: 294 passed'. T-29 batch B (api/identity_id_hardening, api/platform_admin_outside_platform, api/platform_escalation_guard, api/platform_scope_not_conferred, plugs/iss0736_oidc_live_revocation, plugs/iss0778_platform_role_seeding_e2e, routers/identity_test, audit_dispositions, audit_capture, api_token_auth_pipeline, plugs/pending_admin_login_response, routers/onboarding_pending_admin, simulation/req208_meridian) NOT RUN: free memory fell to 2.8-3.2 GB and stayed there; TEST-RUNNER/CI must run it. mix format --check-formatted on the 5 touched test files rc=0; MIX_ENV=test mix compile --warnings-as-errors rc=0. MUTANTS (non-existence case; applied in an isolated scratch copy of lib/config/priv/test/deps/_build because lib/ must not be edited while ELIXIR-DEV works there; each reverted and the revert checked; copy deleted): M1 tenant_wide_admins_query/2 'where: u.status == :active' removed -> tenant_wide_admins_test 2 failures (T-21, T-35); M3 lock_tenant_admins!/1 does not issue pg_advisory_xact_lock -> tenant_wide_admins_test 'Result: 17/19 passed' (T-25 outside-transaction control, T-33 held lock blocks add); M4 AuditContext.normalize_trace_id/1 control-character check removed -> audit_context_test 3 failures (SEC-A4 x2, current_trace_id/0). M1 and M4 were measured in one run on disjoint files: 'Result: 28/33 passed'. FIXTURE FIX (assertion intent unchanged): test/letflow/identity/pending_admin_binding_test.exs, the two concurrent-binder tests. The bind now takes the tenant admin advisory lock before the grant row, so the second binder waits on the advisory lock and PendingAdminHelper.lock_waiters?(pending_tenant_admin_grants, 2) can never reach 2 (the binders then hit their 2s lock_timeout). Replaced at both call sites by a local binders_blocked?/1 counting grant-row FOR UPDATE waiters OR pg_advisory_xact_lock waiters, same 20,000 round-trip bound; the file passes in batch A. Not run against the unfixed helper (memory); the need follows from the lock order in transact_bind/8. No other existing test needed a change in the runs above. NOTES: the bit-62 flip branch of tenant_admin_lock_key/1 cannot be reached by a practical fixture (needs a SHA-256 prefix inside int32), so only its effect (range) is tested; T-31 uses RoleRegistry.seed_default_platform_role_groups/1 (the seed onboarding runs), not the onboarding router. started_at is the first test artifact write still on disk.
